simple.meaning: תְּרוּמִיָּה (tᵉrûwmîyâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a sacrificial offering.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 48:12. Its contexts include offering, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תְּרוּמִיָּה (H8642).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H8642. terumiyyah תְּרוּמִיָּה noun feminine denominative what belongs to a contribution , attendant or secondary contribution, subdivision (on form. see Kö ii. 1, 204 ; strictly adjective (used as substantive), Ges § 86h ); — הָאָרֶץ מִתְּרוּמַת ׳ת Ezek 48:12 , of strip of land for priests in Ezekiel's scheme (but read probably תְּרוּמָה ).
